vocab.definition: the mass of product actually made.
the maximum mass that could be made.
a reaction that lowers yield as it goes both ways.

misconceptions.right: Product is lost, so yield is usually below 100%.

misconceptions.wrong: Yield and atom economy are the same.
misconceptions.right: Yield = how much; atom economy = how efficient.

misconceptions.wrong: Low yield means the equation is wrong.
misconceptions.right: Losses happen during transfer and side reactions.

infoPanels.title: PERCENTAGE YIELD
formulaLines: % yield = actual yieldtheoretical yield × 100
